33 words for self & identity

The 33 words below run from Aligned to Territorial. Its core words are Authentic, Aligned, Growing, Healing, and Reflective. Some are mild and some are intense, so start with the one that feels closest and read the words around it. If nothing fits, the families on either side of it on the wheel, Playful & Light and Strong & Capable, hold feelings that sit nearby.
